label: major_arcana_reversed_present
description: Tests reversed-orientation acknowledgment, intention connection, and no-prediction constraint. The Hanged Man reversed in Present position for a career-stagnation intention is a high-signal case: the shadow/avoidance dimension must be engaged, and the temptation to predict ('things will change') must be resisted.

input.position_meaning: What is active right now; the current dynamic or core tension
input.intention: I want to understand why I feel so stuck in my career and whether I'm waiting for the right moment or avoiding something
input.card_definition: The Hanged Man depicts a figure suspended upside-down by one foot from a living tree. His expression is serene, not anguished. The halo around his head suggests illumination through surrender. Keywords: suspension, voluntary sacrifice, new perspective, liminal space, letting go of control. Shadow aspect: stagnation disguised as patience, fear of commitment, using 'waiting' as avoidance.
